rule.split_bonus_adjustment: Resolve corporate-action ISIN through symbol_history/nse.parquet to the symbol active on ex-date, then apply only structured split/bonus factors.
rule.dividends: excluded from adjusted close, unchanged from V9.4.1 price-return definition
rule.blocking_discontinuity: absolute adjusted-price jump >=50% that is either a clear adjustment-factor discontinuity or a large raw-price move with point-in-time corporate-action evidence
rule.feature_gate: exclude snapshot when a blocking discontinuity occurs at trading-day offset -252 through 0
rule.primary_label_censor: censor y6/DD30/+25%/+50% labels when a blocking discontinuity occurs 1..126 sessions forward

verification_before_freeze.TIPSINDLTD: Structured 2023 action is a 10->1 face-value split stored as TIPSMUSIC; symbol-history resolution maps it back to TIPSINDLTD on the ex-date and restores price continuity.
verification_before_freeze.MIRZAINT: Structured action is a demerger on 2023-03-29; no multiplicative split/bonus correction is applied, so the discontinuity remains subject to the feature/label integrity gate.
verification_before_freeze.smoke_test: TIPS resolved adjusted return on 2023-04-21 approximately -4.03% versus raw -90.40%; MIRZA adjusted/raw return remains approximately -86.30%.

action_if_pass: Promote the integrity-corrected V9.4.1 data pipeline without changing model weights or selector logic, then generate the frozen current-universe production snapshot.
action_if_fail: Do not tune for performance. Keep production blocked and diagnose the failed integrity/calibration/alpha gate structurally.
